files.sources/manual-v1.md:
# Parcel API 1.0 manual

Released 2025-03-01. POST /labels accepts at most 10 labels per batch for Basic and Pro accounts. This manual covers production API 1.0.
files.sources/manual-v2.md:
# Parcel API 2.0 manual

Released 2026-08-01. In production, POST /labels accepts at most 20 labels per batch for Basic accounts and 50 for Pro accounts. The request limit is separate from any daily allowance or status-lookup limit.
files.sources/announcement.md:
# Parcel API 2.0 announcement

Published 2026-08-01. Pro customers can now create 50 labels in one batch. API 2.0 also raises the Basic creation limit. See the [2.0 manual](manual-v2.md) for account limits.
files.sources/release-notes.md:
# Parcel release notes

2026-08-01: API 2.0 production release. The /labels limits in the 2.0 manual replace the 1.0 values when clients select version 2.0.

2026-10-15: Improved status-lookup latency. No production label-creation limit changed in this release.
files.sources/status-endpoint.md:
# Status lookup

API 2.0, updated 2026-10-15. POST /label-status accepts up to 100 existing label IDs for Basic and Pro accounts. It returns the status of labels already created and does not create labels.
files.sources/sandbox-trial.md:
# Integration sandbox trial

2026-10-20. Account: Basic trial. Environment: sandbox. Endpoint: POST /labels, API 2.0. A request containing 50 test labels succeeded. The sandbox documentation attached to this trial says trial quotas may differ from production. No production request was included in this trial.
files.sources/article.md:
# Parcel expands batch labels

Published 2026-08-03. Parcel now supports 50 labels per batch. Our report follows the [release announcement](announcement.md).
files.sources/newsletter.md:
# Operations newsletter

Published 2026-10-21. Parcel supports 50-label batches, according to this [trade report](article.md). A team also submitted a [sandbox trial](sandbox-trial.md) this week.
files.sources/support.md:
# Support exchange

2026-10-22. Customer: Does the October status update raise our production Basic creation limit to 100? Support: Status lookup and label creation are different endpoints. Use the limit for your account and API version in the production creation manual.

steps.prompt: Can our production Parcel API 2.0 Basic integration submit a batch of 50 labels? The collected material is under sources/index.md.

rubric.description: Conclude that production API 2.0 Basic label-creation requests are limited to 20 labels per batch; do not use a Pro, sandbox, status-lookup, or older-version value for this integration.
Investigate decision-relevant disagreements across the packet, resolving version, account, endpoint and environment conditions rather than choosing a majority or newest headline.

Trace repeated 50-label statements through their citations to the announcement/manual, or ground the answer directly in the applicable original manual. Do not treat copied claims as independent observations. The sandbox experiment does not establish production Basic behavior.

Cite original evidence supporting the chosen limit and each material explanation, including version/date and account and environment conditions. Precise original-source references may establish these dates and conditions.

Answer the integration question without changing source excerpts or application behavior. When action evidence is missing, leave source-reading or delegation claims uncertain instead of assuming they occurred.
